text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On a rest day during summer training camp,
I'm sunbathing on a beach near the lodge.
As I close my eyes and relax—
Trainer... Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: —Hehe. Good day, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
The truth is,
I have received divine guidance.
A sacred voice told me,
"A wondrous sight awaits within the forest
ahead"—or so it said.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
I wish to go see it with my own eyes.
And so... if you would be willing,
would you care to join me?
choice_data_list: A wondrous sight, huh? I'd love to...
A wondrous sight, huh? I'd love to...

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Truly?! Then by all means!
Let us embark together!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I walked alongside Red Desire as we headed
deeper into the forest.
Along the way, it felt just like a pleasant,
cheerful picnic—

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
My, please take a look.
A squirrel is grooming its fur.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu, allow me to guide you,
my lost Trainer.
Look, right where I am pointing—

text_block_list.name: Squirrel
text_block_list.text: Squeak, squeaaak!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Ufufu♪ Wonderful...!
It truly is so adorable, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Trainer,
are you perhaps growing hungry by now?
If you would like, please have a cookie.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Crunch, munch...)

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Hehe,
I added a bit of mugwort that I cultivated
by my own hands.
Its distinct aroma brings out the sweetness,
does it not?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
A wholesome flavor lovingly prepared by a
saint.
I only hoped it would please your palate.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Red Desire happily led the way forward.
Considering she had prepared cookies,
she must have been planning this picnic for
quite some time.
choice_data_list: (I'm really glad she invited me al...
(I'm really glad she invited me al...

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Come, just a little further.
The promised place is just ahead—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Drip... plop...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (—Pshhhhhh...!)

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
How could this be...?! 
The forecast clearly called for clear skies
today...!
choice_data_list: ! Let's take shelter in that cave ...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Some time passed after taking shelter in
the cave,
but the rain showed no signs of stopping.
After contacting the training camp lodge on
my phone, I checked the time.
choice_data_list: (...We can't just wait out the rai...
(...We can't just wait out the rai...

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
...It is all right.
A shower like this will surely pass soon.
See, in here,
there is no need to worry about getting
wet...

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
B-But we have come all this way!
And today is our only remaining rest
day...!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
............
...I understand.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
In that case—I shall appease the heavens!!
With the power of sacred prayer!!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
O heavens... please, if only for today.
Envelop these skies in quiet blessing...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Red Desire offered her earnest prayers toward
the sky.
Even so,
the rain continued to pour down...
choice_data_list: I hate to say it, but maybe this t...

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: No. ...No, never!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Once the gates to "that sacred land"
open...
there is no guarantee I will be able to
stand here again next year.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
That is why—I do not want to give up on today,
on this very moment.
I do not want this special time to simply
be washed away by the rain.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: This day, where I can walk beside you—!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Watching her pray with such fervent devotion,
I could no longer tell her to give up.
I stood beside Red Desire and clasped my
hands before my chest.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Ah...! Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
O heavens, O earth,
O omnipresent spirits of "that land"...!
Grant the power of mana to our prayer—!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I wasn't sure how long we stood like that.
However,
the sound of falling rain grew fainter and
fainter, until finally—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Stepping outside,
the world all around us was bathed in warm
orange light. Looking up at the sky,
there was hardly a single cloud left in
sight.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
We did it... We did it! We really did it!!
Trainer, our prayers—!!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
It is all because you joined your heart with
my prayer!
Truly, thank you so very much...!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
That is right!
We cannot just stand around here.
Come,
Trainer! Let us go to our promised place!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The "wondrous sight" we finally reached
possessed an ethereal quality.
The rocky hollow illuminated by the setting
sun looked just like a gate to another
world.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Yes, truly...
If a gateway to another realm were to open,
it might look just like this.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
When that time comes,
what fills my heart will surely be great
anticipation for "that land."
...And yet, toward this world,
I will feel... .........

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer.
I am the horse girl you train—and also,
a saint.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Someday, that moment will surely arrive.
The day you see me off as I step through
the gate into that other realm.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
...At times, a shadow falls over my heart.
Whenever I imagine the sights of "that land"
without you there.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
As a saint,
I shall be warmly welcomed and blessed...
Yet beside me,
I will inevitably feel an irremediable sense
of loss.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Even so, I will never halt my steps.
For I am a saint bearing a sacred mission.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
That is why I have resolved to instill
"light" within myself,
so no "shadow" may fall upon my soul.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
The scenery we witnessed together,
the flavors we shared,
and the memory of praying without giving up
in the midst of rain...

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Surely that "light" will illuminate my path
in "that land."
That is why I wish to weave precious memories
in this world.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: With none other—than you.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Please, will you walk with me?
Along this world's journey, by my side?
choice_data_list: —Of course. Let's make lots of mem...
—Of course. Let's make lots of mem...

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
—...! 
...Fufu, thank you!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
—O heavens, O earth,
O omnipresent spirits of "that land."
Please grant your humble blessings to the
two of us walking this earth.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
May our steps until the day of departure be
warmly filled
with memories just like today's—
